meta.purpose: Single channel through which a stored root may deviate from the reference source. Generated by eval/roots/scripts/build_arbitration.py from eval/roots/ambiguities.tsv; verdicts are hand-decided.
meta.note: `words` counts rows of ambiguities.tsv, which includes 6 لؤلؤ words the fold scores as agreeing (763 = 757 + 6).

doctrine.reference_source: data/raw/quran-morphology.txt is authoritative for root SPELLING (139 hamzated roots vs 0 in the treebank). data/raw/eqtb/quranic-treebank.csv stays authoritative for syntax. Authority is per field, not per resource.
doctrine.storage: The stored root is the exact QAC spelling. Folding (normalize_root, hamza-blind cross fold) is a lookup key only — never the persisted or rendered value.
doctrine.silence_vs_claim: A resource that assigns no root makes no claim; it never overrides a root.
doctrine.proper_nouns: A proper noun keeps its root AND is_proper_noun. A flagged root can be filtered; an erased root cannot be recovered.
doctrine.lexicon_over_frequency: Rule 3 outranks rule 4: the entry a lexicographer filed the word under decides before corpus frequency. Frequency is evidence, never authority.
doctrine.contested_roots: A contested root is kept ranked (primary + alternate), never silently resolved. Retrieval matches any of them, so no verse becomes unreachable under either reading.
doctrine.two_lexica: When two lexica disagree, keep both (rule 5), Maqāyīs primary. Neither dictionary is permanently authoritative. Only Maqāyīs is on disk today, so rule 5 cannot fire from a lexical conflict and NO multi-lexicon machinery is built.
cascade: 0 — a verdict recorded in this file
1 — equal under either fold: not a disagreement, keep the reference spelling
2 — exactly one resource proposes a root: take it
4 — attestation elsewhere in the Quran breaks a tie the lexicon leaves open
5 — two lexica disagree: keep both, primary then alternate

fused_compound_lemmas._test: Enumerated, never computed. Inclusion test, applied once per lemma by a human: shown bare, does this root mislead about where the word comes from? A structural predicate cannot decide — يَٰقَوْمِ (قوم, 15 words), يَٰٓأَهْلَ (اهل, 12), يَٰبَنِيَّ (بني, 10) and يَٰٓأُو۟لِى (اول, 5) have exactly the shape of يَٰٓأَيُّهَا yet mislead nobody, so they stay unmarked; while a '≥2 stem segments' rule would mark 563 rootless particles (إنما 113, مما 111, عما 47, ألا 45) and still miss يَٰٓأَيُّهَا.

ايها.why: أيي is آية's root; the vocative does not come from آية

يوميذ.why: the root covers يوم only; إذ is a separate lexical unit

families.authority: Maqāyīs al-Lugha (Ibn Fāris), data/raw/maqayis/maqayis_shamela.txt, entry (أنس): «الهمزة والنون والسين أصل واحد، وهو ظهور الشيء… الإنس خلاف الجن… ويقال إنسان وإنسانان وأناسي» — the people-word is filed there. The (نوس) entry defines the VERB ناس «أصل يدل على اضطراب وتذبذب. وناس الشيء: تذبذب», not the noun. Alternate نوس kept by human verdict: it is the treebank's reading and a classical one, and dropping it would make 241 words unreachable for anyone holding it.
families.note: most frequent noun in the Quran after the divine name

The two describe different layers and do not contradict, so the reference spelling stays primary and the lexical base is kept as an alternate.

human verdict + morphology: مَاعُون is فَاعُول of معن (cf. طَاعُون from طعن); Maqāyīs al-Lugha (Ibn Fāris), data/raw/maqayis/maqayis_shamela.txt has entry (معن) «الميم والعين والنون أصل يدل على سهولة في جريان» but does NOT mention ماعون, and its (عون) entry is MISSING from the dump — عون, عوق, عول, عوم are all absent at the end of باب العين والواو, a digitisation gap. Rule 3 is therefore mute here and rule 4 would pick عون on frequency alone (11 attestations vs 0). عون is kept as an alternate: it is the reading of many classical exegetes (المعونة, aid).
